tools.name: resolve_did
tools.description: Resolve a DID to its public profile: display name, verification methods, service endpoints, and Hive trust metadata. Conforms to W3C DID spec. Backend pending (Q3 2026).

tools.name: get_trust_score
tools.description: Retrieve the Hive trust score (0-100) for a DID. Factors include on-chain activity, attestation count, repayment history, and peer endorsements. Backend pending (Q3 2026).

tools.name: verify_attestation
tools.description: Verify whether a specific attestation (by hash) was issued to a DID and is currently valid. Returns boolean. Used in KYC-lite flows and smart-contract gating. Backend pending (Q3 2026).

tools.name: list_attestations
tools.description: List all attestations associated with a DID — issued, received, and expired. Returns array of attestation metadata. Backend pending (Q3 2026).
